entities.summary: Karvel Markeese Anderson is an American basketball player. He is from Elkhart, Indiana. Anderson played two years, from 2010 to 2012, at Glen Oaks Community College then from 2012 to 2014 at the D-I level for the Robert Morris Colonials of the Northeast Conference. Anderson was named Northeast Conference Player of the Year in 2014.
